question: On what basis do some initiates maintain faith without discernment?
premises: Some initiates do not abandon their faith in a given initiation.
Their faith may rest on scriptural authority rather than discernment.
In the absence of discernment, they may also rely on common repute.
inference: Faith in initiation can be sustained by scripture or social convention even when personal discernment is lacking.
uncertainties: The verse compresses two bases of faith, scripture and common repute, into a tight contrast with discernment.
plain_english: Such people do not abandon their faith in that initiation, even if it rests on scriptural authority. Lacking discernment, they hold to it on the strength of scripture and common repute.
